note: Draw.io icon styles used by build_drawio.py. The icon policy is the same for AWS, Azure and GCP: 'stencils' (Draw.io's own shape libraries, tried first) -> 'sidebar_images' (SVG icons Draw.io embeds in its sidebar for services without a stencil; synced mechanically by maintenance/sync_sidebar_icons.py) -> a plain box with the service name, drawn by build_drawio.py when nothing matches. Each stencil entry declares its provider so a GCP diagram does not pick up an AWS icon. 'aliases' maps the names people actually write onto catalog keys; a list means try each key in order. 'stencil_svgs' holds pre-rendered SVGs for the exporter (maintenance/render_stencils.py).
